**Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)** is a technique used to improve AI models by incorporating human judgment into the training process. In RLHF, human raters evaluate the outputs generated by the model based on their helpfulness and harmlessness. These ratings are then used to adjust the model's behavior so that it learns to produce responses that align more closely with what humans deem appropriate or safe.

**Pattern matching** in AI models refers to the ability of these systems to recognize and respond to specific sequences or structures in data based on their training. In this context, models like language models have been trained to identify patterns in language and behavior, allowing them to predict appropriate responses.
